entities.name: Caroline
entities.description: A transgender woman who began transitioning around 2020 and moved from her home country, Sweden, around 2019. She is pursuing a career in counseling and mental health, is adopting as a single parent, volunteers and mentors in LGBTQ community organisations, paints and draws, and plays acoustic guitar. Melanie calls her Caro. She turned 18 around 2013, so she was about 28 in 2023.

entities.name: Melanie
entities.description: Caroline's friend, a married mother of at least three children who juggles family and work. She paints, took up pottery in July 2023, runs to de-stress, and camps and hikes with her family. Caroline calls her Mel. She has been making art for about seven years as of 2023 and was married around 2018.

entities.name: Melanie's husband
entities.description: Melanie's spouse, never named in the conversation and referred to as "my husband" and "my partner". They married around 2018 and have at least three children together; Melanie says he and the children keep her motivated.

entities.name: Amy Ellis Nutt
entities.description: The author of "Becoming Nicole", the book Caroline names as her favourite guide.

entities.name: Sara Bareilles
entities.description: The singer-songwriter behind "Brave", the song Caroline says has the most significance for her.

entities.name: Matt Patterson
entities.description: The musician whose concert Melanie attended on 13 August 2023 for her daughter's birthday; she praised his voice and songs.

entities.name: Oliver
entities.description: Melanie's dog, one of the household's pets alongside the cat Luna and, from August 2023, a second cat named Bailey. He once hid his bone in Melanie's slipper.

entities.name: Luna
entities.description: Melanie's cat, one of two pets along with the dog Oliver until a second cat, Bailey, arrived by August 2023.

entities.name: Bailey
entities.description: The second cat Melanie's household acquired, first mentioned on 23 August 2023, joining the dog Oliver and the cat Luna.

entities.name: Oscar
entities.description: Caroline's guinea pig, mentioned on 23 August 2023. His favourite food is parsley and vegetables generally.

entities.name: Sweden
entities.description: Caroline's home country, which she left around 2019. Her grandmother, who gave her the cross-and-heart necklace she treasures, lives there.

entities.name: Grand Canyon
entities.description: The destination Melanie's children enjoyed on the family road trip of 14-15 October 2023, the trip on which her son was in a car accident.

entities.name: LGBTQ support group
entities.description: The LGBTQ support group Caroline attended on 7 May 2023 and credits with making her feel accepted and giving her the courage to embrace herself. Transgender members' stories told there inspired her.

entities.name: LGBTQ-friendly adoption agency

properties.aliases: the adoption agency; one of the adoption agencies

entities.description: The unnamed adoption agency Caroline picked out in May 2023 because it helps LGBTQ+ people adopt. She applied in the week of 21 August 2023 and passed its interviews on 20 October 2023. She also spoke of "adoption agencies" in the plural, so the application may have gone to more than this one.

entities.name: Connected LGBTQ Activists
entities.description: The LGBTQ activist group Caroline joined on 18 July 2023. It holds regular meetings and plans events and campaigns, and its members invest in positive change.

entities.name: LGBTQ youth mentorship program
entities.description: The mentorship program for LGBTQ youth Caroline joined over the weekend of 15-16 July 2023. Through it she mentors a transgender teenager on confidence and coping strategies.

entities.name: LGBTQ+ youth center
entities.description: The LGBTQ+ youth center where Caroline volunteered before 28 August 2023 and intended to keep volunteering; she and it were organising a talent show for the young people in September 2023. Caroline also mentioned visiting "a LGBTQ center" in July 2023 that inspired a painting, which may or may not be this place; they are recorded here as one because nothing distinguishes them.

entities.name: Melanie's pottery class
entities.description: The pottery class Melanie signed up for on 2 July 2023 and attended through 2023, making a black-and-white flower bowl, a colourful bowl and a flower-decorated plate. She had to take a break from pottery in September 2023 after an injury.

entities.name: Summer Sounds
entities.description: The band Melanie saw play an outdoor concert in a park before 28 August 2023; they played a pop song that got the crowd dancing and singing.

entities.name: Becoming Nicole
entities.description: Amy Ellis Nutt's true story about a trans girl and her family. Caroline names it as her favourite guide, says it taught her self-acceptance and how to find support, and recommended it to Melanie, who was reading it by October 2023.

entities.name: Charlotte's Web
entities.description: Melanie's favourite book from her childhood; she says it showed how friendship and compassion can make a difference.

entities.name: Brave
entities.description: The Sara Bareilles song Caroline says has deep significance for her, because it is about being courageous and fighting for what is right and makes her think about the progress she has made.

entities.name: Embracing Identity
entities.description: Caroline's painting of a woman, shown to Melanie on 14 August 2023. It is about finding comfort and love in being yourself, with the woman standing for the journey of acceptance; Caroline aimed to convey warmth, love and self-acceptance.

entities.name: Caroline's cross-and-heart necklace
entities.description: A necklace with a cross and a heart, given to Caroline when she was young by her grandmother in Sweden. It stands for love, faith and strength and reminds her of her roots and her family's support.

entities.name: Caroline's hand-painted bowl
entities.description: A hand-painted bowl a friend made for Caroline's 18th birthday around 2013. She keeps it for its pattern and colours and as a reminder of art and self-expression.

entities.name: Painting
entities.description: The art form both women practise. Melanie paints landscapes, still life, animals, sunsets and nature scenes, often with her children; Caroline paints to express her trans experience and explore her identity, and moved towards abstract work by October 2023.

entities.name: Pottery
entities.description: Melanie's craft from July 2023. She calls it therapy and a huge part of her life rather than a hobby, made several bowls and a plate, took her children to a pottery workshop, and had to pause it after an injury in September 2023. Caroline had still not tried it as of 13 September 2023.

entities.name: Running
entities.description: Melanie runs to de-stress and clear her mind. It is part of her daily me-time from May 2023, she ran a mental health charity race on 20 May 2023, she had been running longer distances by July 2023, and she bought new running shoes in July 2023.

entities.name: Camping
entities.description: Melanie's family's recurring activity and, she says, the highlight of their summer: marshmallows, campfire stories and nature. Trips include the mountains in June 2023, the beach, the forest, a weekend in July 2023, and a 2022 trip on which they watched the Perseid meteor shower.

entities.name: Hiking
entities.description: Walking in the mountains and forests. Melanie's family hike together regularly; Caroline was hiking in August 2023 when she had an upsetting encounter with a group of religious conservatives.

entities.name: Playing the acoustic guitar
entities.description: Caroline has played acoustic guitar since about 2018 and says it helps her get her emotions out and express herself.

entities.name: Caroline's mental health struggles
entities.description: Caroline struggled with her mental health and found the support she received helpful. It is the reason she began looking into counseling and mental health as a career and why she wants others to have someone to talk to.

entities.name: Caroline's gender transition
entities.description: Caroline's transition as a transgender woman, begun around 2020. She speaks about it publicly at school events, conferences and poetry readings, credits friends, family and mentors with supporting her through it, made art throughout it, and says some friendships did not survive it while the rest became more genuine.

entities.name: Caroline's adoption
entities.description: Caroline's plan to adopt as a single parent, which she calls a lifelong dream. She researched agencies in May 2023, attended an adoption council meeting in July 2023, applied to agencies in the week of 21 August 2023, consulted her mentor in October 2023 and passed the agency interviews on 20 October 2023.

entities.name: Caroline's counseling and mental health career
entities.description: Caroline's pursuit of a career in counseling or mental health, first mentioned on 8 May 2023 and returned to in almost every session. She wants to work with trans people, helping them accept themselves, and attended an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop on 23 June 2023 as part of it.

entities.name: Caroline's LGBTQ art show
entities.description: An art show of Caroline's paintings alongside other LGBTQ artists, meant to spread understanding and acceptance. She first planned it for August 2023 on 17 July 2023 and then described it as happening the following month again on 25 August 2023, putting it in September 2023.

entities.name: Caroline's children's library
entities.description: The library of children's books Caroline was assembling in July 2023 for the children she hopes to adopt: classics, stories from different cultures and educational books. She looks forward to reading to them.
